articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Vision, and Audio
articles.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that can simultaneously process and cross-reference code repositories, visual diagrams, and spoken instructions in a single inference pass. Benchmarks show a 40% improvement on SWE-Bench and ARC-AGI-2 compared to the original GPT-5 release. The model also introduces a persistent memory architecture that maintains context across sessions without explicit retrieval-augmented generation.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Mathematical Olympiad Problems
articles.summary: DeepMind announced that Gemini Ultra 2 solved 88% of International Mathematical Olympiad 2026 problems at a gold-medal level, a significant leap from last year's performance. The system uses a novel chain-of-thought distillation method combined with formal verification through Lean 4, allowing it to not only generate proofs but verify their correctness. This represents a milestone in AI-driven formal mathematics and has implications for automated theorem proving in software verification.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in Amazon Warehouses
articles.summary: Tesla's third-generation Optimus humanoid robot has started a pilot deployment across three Amazon fulfillment centers in Texas, performing pick-and-pack operations alongside human workers. The Gen 3 model features improved dexterous manipulation with 22 degrees of freedom per hand and a new vision-language-action model that lets it interpret natural language task instructions on the fly. Amazon reports a 15% throughput improvement in mixed human-robot workflows during initial trials.

articles.title: Figure AI Raises $1.5B Series C, Demonstrates Autonomous Construction Site Robot
articles.summary: Figure AI closed a $1.5 billion Series C at an $18 billion valuation after demonstrating its Figure 03 humanoid robot autonomously performing framing and material transport tasks on an active construction site in Denver. The robot operates for 6 hours on a single charge and uses a world-model-based planner to navigate unstructured terrain. The funding will accelerate deployment partnerships with three major U.S. construction firms targeting chronic labor shortages in the sector.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces 'Constitutional Classifiers' for Enterprise AI Safety Guardrails
articles.summary: Anthropic released a new open-source framework called Constitutional Classifiers, enabling enterprises to define domain-specific safety boundaries for LLM-powered applications using natural language constitutions rather than brittle keyword filters. The system uses a lightweight classifier distilled from Claude that runs as a sidecar at inference time with sub-10ms latency overhead. Early adopters in healthcare and finance report a 70% reduction in policy violations compared to traditional content filtering approaches.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm GAA Process Node for Next-Gen AI Accelerators
articles.summary: TSMC announced volume production at its Fab 21 facility in Arizona using its N1.4 gate-all-around transistor process, with NVIDIA and Broadcom confirmed as launch customers for AI accelerator chips. The node delivers a 25% performance uplift and 35% power reduction compared to N2, critical for the power-constrained scaling of next-generation data center GPUs. This marks the first sub-2nm volume production on U.S. soil and a key milestone in semiconductor supply chain diversification.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Approval for Second-Generation Brain-Computer Interface Implant
articles.summary: Neuralink secured FDA approval for its N2 implant, which doubles the electrode count to 2,048 channels and introduces bidirectional stimulation capability, enabling both neural reading and targeted feedback. The approval covers expanded clinical trials for patients with spinal cord injuries, building on promising results from the first-generation cohort where participants achieved reliable cursor and robotic arm control. The N2 uses a fully wireless design with on-chip signal processing that reduces external hardware requirements.

articles.title: Meta Open-Sources Llama 4 Behemoth with Mixture-of-Experts Architecture at 1.2 Trillion Parameters
articles.summary: Meta released Llama 4 Behemoth under its community license, a 1.2 trillion parameter mixture-of-experts model that activates only 120B parameters per forward pass, making it runnable on a single 8×H200 node. The model outperforms GPT-4o on multilingual benchmarks across 47 languages and introduces a novel expert routing mechanism that allows dynamic specialization during fine-tuning. The open-source release is expected to significantly shift the balance between proprietary and open-weight frontier models for enterprise deployment.
